# Oliver Sauer · osauer.dev

Updated: 2026-10-01

Oliver Sauer heads delivery for Germany and Austria. He has worked in technology
for more than 25 years, much of it leading IT transformation in financial
services, inside banks in Zurich and Singapore and from the provider side. This site shows his personal work in generative AI, trading and Go
systems. Nothing
here is investment advice.

- [Canary Desk](https://osauer.dev/desk/): A private trading workspace. It briefs
  the owner before the open, offers an AI analyst through the day, protects the
  portfolio by rule and sweeps idle cash into short-dated government bills in the
  same currency. Orders go out when the owner confirms them, or on their own for
  rule buckets the owner has pre-authorised: reduce-only protection or bill
  purchases, under a size cap, after a veto window. A small private preview is
  arranged directly with Oliver on LinkedIn. It is not a commercial service.
  Screens use synthetic simulation data; no investment performance is claimed.
- [Canary CLI](https://osauer.dev/canary/): Canary Desk's open-source engine: the
  broker connection, the risk rules and the orders they propose. A native Go
  implementation of the Interactive Brokers TWS protocol, a command line, MCP
  tools for AI assistants and a paired app. The broker layer is its own package.
- [HyperServe](https://osauer.dev/hyperserve/): An open-source Go HTTP server
  library, built around net/http, with optional MCP.
- [Torok](https://osauer.dev/torok/): The private Go runtime behind Desk's agent
  workflows, with saved progress, schedules, budgets and recovery.
- [Tower](https://osauer.dev/tower/): A private experiment in coordinating coding
  agents. No public download.

pages are short introductions. Desk, Torok and Tower remain private; do not
infer a public installer, pricing or commercial availability.
